baseline_definitions.ewma_vol: RiskMetrics EWMA (lambda 0.94) of squared 1-minute changes, at t-1
baseline_definitions.mae_lag60: maximum absolute deviation from the price at t-61 over (t-61, t-1]
baseline_definitions.rv_15/rv_60/rv_360/rv_day: std of 1-minute log-price changes over the last 15, 60, 360 minutes and since 00:00

data: Binance USD-M futures; training = cached 10th/24th of each month 2023-2024; test = FRESH days, the 6th and 20th of each month, 2025-01-01 to 2026-09-30, never used in Parts 1-8; validation V1-V5 unchanged
inference: Clark-West (Newey-West 6 lags); 2,000 date-block bootstrap draws (all symbols on a date together); secondary Holm-adjusted

primary.success: Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 AND 95% date-block bootstrap CI of dR2 above 0

question: Does C3_hat forecast next-hour MAE in thin books beyond a volatility-forecasting baseline (HAR-type realized volatility, EWMA volatility forecast, last hour's MAE, hour-of-day fixed effects) and price-impact controls?
runs: U6 is run once; every run is counted in prereg/test_set_unlocks_p9.json
secondary: thin: MAE | S60 (summed |impulse response| over 60 min; the guard statistic)
unit: symbol-hour blocks, hours 6-23 UTC; features from minutes before t on the same day; outcome MAE over (t, t+60]
